properties.Mechanism (MOA): PDE3 inhibitor → ↑cAMP in cardiac myocytes and vascular smooth muscle → positive inotropy + improved relaxation (lusitropy) + arterial/venous vasodilation (inodilator) → ↑cardiac output and ↓preload/afterload.
properties.Contraindications: Hypersensitivity; caution/avoid in significant hypotension, severe obstructive valvular lesions (e.g., critical aortic stenosis), and in patients at high risk of tachyarrhythmias; dose-adjust in renal impairment.
properties.Indications: Short-term IV support in acute decompensated heart failure/low-output states; post–cardiac surgery low cardiac output; sometimes RV failure/pulmonary hypertension with elevated PVR.
properties.Adverse effects: Arrhythmias (atrial/ventricular), hypotension (vasodilation), headache; accumulation/toxicity risk in renal impairment.
